name: PT Arrtu Energie Resources
summary: PT Arrtu Energie Resources is an oil palm company in Ketapang, West Kalimantan. Nusantara Atlas satellite data, as reported by The Jakarta Post, show at least 978 ha burned inside its holding between January and July 2026, the largest burned area among Kalimantan concessions in that analysis. The Jakarta Post describes the company as a subsidiary of Nova Plantation Group. We did not find a filing or registry record to confirm that, so no parent is stated in the data. This profile does not establish who lit any fire.

burnedHa.method: Burned area inside the concession for January to July 2026, as measured by Nusantara Atlas and reported by The Jakarta Post (published 11 September 2026). We did not measure it ourselves and have not seen the underlying Nusantara Atlas dataset. The figure is given as 'at least 978 ha' and the article lists the company first among the ten concessions with the largest burned area.

evidence.summary: Nusantara Atlas satellite data, as reported by The Jakarta Post, show at least 978 ha burned inside the concession between January and July 2026. This is satellite detection of burned area. It does not show how the fires began.
